articles.title: MiCA revolutionised European crypto, and left Poland licking its wounds
articles.snippet: Many in Poland may look back at 2026 as the year European crypto finally grew up, and one of Poland’s brightest economic ambitions faded into darkness, writes Mateusz Kara, founder and CEO of Morphic Financial Group.

articles.title: Bitcoin hits $80,000 for the first time since May as crypto recovery accelerates
articles.snippet: BTC has now surged 38% following its June plunge as shifting U.S. Treasury policy helped bring buyers back to crypto, rejuvenating ETF demand.

articles.title: Crypto political group details list of U.S. congressional allies its backing this year
articles.snippet: Stand With Crypto, a member group that rates the crypto friendliness of politicians, is supporting 32 U.S. House incumbents, with more endorsements coming.

articles.title: CFTC, US soldier accused of illegal Polymarket bet spar over interpretation of prediction markets
articles.snippet: A judge stayed the CFTC’s civil case against a soldier who allegedly used nonpublic information for a Polymarket bet, but the regulator is trying to weigh in on the criminal case.

articles.title: Coinbase-affiliated advocacy group endorses candidates for US midterms
articles.snippet: With just over two months until the US general election, Stand With Crypto announced its pick for politicians in its efforts to “elect the most pro-crypto Congress in history.”
